lisboa_repair_project.title: Lisboa Repair Project
lisboa_repair_project.subtitle: Repair is climate action. And it starts with all of us.
lisboa_repair_project.desc: A community-powered initiative to make repair visible, accessible, and collective in Lisbon. We map local repair shops, celebrate artisans, and promote the circular economy.
lisboa_repair_project.challenge_p1: Lisbon has a long tradition of craftsmanship, frugality and everyday circularity. But as the city becomes more globalised and consumer-driven, this culture is fading.
lisboa_repair_project.challenge_p2: Local repair shops – often run by migrants, women, elderly artisans and family businesses – are closing. Residents struggle to find the ones that remain. And without accessible repair infrastructure, the city drifts further into a linear, wasteful model that operates outside planetary boundaries.
lisboa_repair_project.challenge_highlight: The Lisbon Repair Map is our response to this challenge.
lisboa_repair_project.building_p1: The Lisbon Repair Map is the first community-powered tool to make repair visible, accessible, and collective in our city. It is an open, living platform where residents can find trusted local repair shops, and where repair artisans can share their stories and skills.
lisboa_repair_project.building_p2: But the map is more than a directory. It is a full ecosystem – supported by storytelling, portraits, and hands-on workshops – designed to drive a cultural shift from consumption to regeneration.
lisboa_repair_project.building_quote: We fix objects to strengthen community, keep value local, and build skills for a resilient future. This is the essential, missing layer for a circular economy in Lisbon.
lisboa_repair_project.approach_visible_desc: We map and celebrate every repair shop, from electronics to textiles, shoes to furniture.
lisboa_repair_project.approach_accessible_desc: We build a free, easy-to-use platform available to all Lisbon residents.
lisboa_repair_project.approach_collective_desc: We co-create the map with the community, for the community. Shop owners, residents, and local partners all have a voice in how it grows.
lisboa_repair_project.approach_human_desc: We document the stories behind the shops. Through portraits and interviews, we shine a light on the artisans, migrants, women, and families who keep repair alive.
lisboa_repair_project.who_desc1: The Lisbon Repair Map is a project of Climate Circle Lisbon, an association dedicated to fostering community-driven climate action in the city.
lisboa_repair_project.who_desc2: Climate Circle Lisbon creates spaces, initiatives and relationships to catalyse local, community-led climate action in Lisbon. With a track record of over 60 community events organised in Lisbon, Climate Circle is rooted in collaboration, collective care and action.
lisboa_repair_project.partners_subtitle: This project is made possible through the collaboration of:
lisboa_repair_project.partner_nextturn_desc: A platform and community focused on circular fashion, repair, and sustainable practices in Lisbon. The Next Turn brings deep expertise in circular systems and community engagement.
lisboa_repair_project.partner_arches_desc: Arches makes small-run, high-quality blanks for leading brands in music, art, food, and fashion. Built with longevity in mind, Arches garments are designed to be worn, repaired, and worn again.
lisboa_repair_project.partner_rizoma_desc: A multisectoral cooperative with six active sections: Consumer (Grocery), Culture, Services (Coworking), Housing, Agriculture, and Handicrafts.
lisboa_repair_project.partner_ecolise_desc: We are proud to be a recipient of the Call for Pathfinders grant, which supports community-led initiatives across Europe that are catalysing regenerative transformation.
lisboa_repair_project.journey_step1_desc: The Lisbon Repair Project began as an idea at a community gathering. Through workshops, surveys and bootcamps we refined our vision and built a concrete plan. Winning the Regenerative Communities Fund from Ecolise allows us to move the project forward.
lisboa_repair_project.journey_step2_desc: We have launched our first community surveys to understand what residents and shop owners truly need. Next steps include building the digital map, shaping the visual identity, capturing portraits and interviews, and organising our first community workshop.
lisboa_repair_project.join_desc: The Lisbon Repair Map belongs to all of us. Whether you are a resident who wants to repair, a shop owner who wants to be listed, a photographer or interviewer who wants to document stories, or a partner who wants to collaborate – there is a place for you.
lisboa_repair_project.join_highlight: Together, we can make repair visible, valued, and collective.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.sec1_text: Circulab is a collaborative platform focused on mapping agroecological resources and circular economy initiatives. We respect your privacy and guarantee the protection of your personal data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

privacy.sec2_li2: Publicly submitted information about resources, typologies, and map suggestions.

privacy.sec3_text: Data is processed based on service delivery requested by the user and legitimate interest in promoting agroecological transition. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.sec4_text: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, port, limit, or request erasure of your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us.
privacy.sec5_text: For any questions regarding data privacy, please contact us via our contact form or official email address.
